intent: Route-target container (standalone OnPush) injecting only RoutinesStore. On init calls RoutinesStore.load('default'). Template by RoutinesStore.state composing ChevronStepperComponent[phases] (area stepper), ExerciseStepCardsComponent[steps, selectedStepId] with (stepSelected) -> RoutinesStore.selectStep(stepId: string): void (area list), StepDetailComponent[step=selectedStep] with (completed) -> RoutinesStore.completeSelected(): void and (advanced) -> RoutinesStore.advance(): void (area detail). Consumes RoutinesStore.state: Signal<ViewState>; RoutinesStore.steps: Signal<WorkoutStep[]>; RoutinesStore.phases: Signal<PhaseProgress[]>; RoutinesStore.selectedStepId: Signal<string | null>; RoutinesStore.selectedStep: Signal<WorkoutStep | null>; RoutinesStore.load(routineId: string): void; RoutinesStore.selectStep(stepId: string): void; RoutinesStore.completeSelected(): void; RoutinesStore.advance(): void.
